artifact: Issue #9 M4-2 Capability Lease issuance contract

issuer_boundary.issuer_role: Validate and materialize an already-authorized exact mutation as bounded mechanical authority.
issuer_may: validate trusted principal and exact typed target
bind exact operation and mutation scope
bind Subject and external authority preconditions
bind exact candidate or reservation identity where applicable
bind authorization, approval, and required MaterializedDecision evidence
issuer_boundary.missing_semantic_basis: NEEDS_SEMANTIC_CHOICE or the canonical basis-specific failure; never automatic issuance

exact_binding.binding_rule: A lease is valid only for the exact tuple. A reference/digest representation is valid only if it resolves to the same tuple.

lifecycle.validity: issued lease is valid only before inclusive expiry, with all exact bindings and preconditions still valid
lifecycle.consumption_boundary: Consumption is one-time and must be coupled to the authorized attempt boundary by the later mechanical transaction/journal implementation; fixture copy helpers are not durable state.
lifecycle.revocation_boundary: Revocation invalidates the lease without changing semantic authorization evidence.
lifecycle.expiry_boundary: Expiry invalidates the lease without changing semantic authorization evidence.

unknown_outcome_protocol.prior_attempt_reuse: no blind reuse of the original lease
unknown_outcome_protocol.exact_candidate_already_applied: classify verified/replayed result; perform no second write
unknown_outcome_protocol.original_external_state_remains: a new bounded lease may be issued only after semantic authorization, Subject precondition, fresh external precondition, and contract hash are revalidated
unknown_outcome_protocol.third_external_state: CONFLICT; no automatic overwrite or reissue

idempotency_binding.same_key_same_semantic_intent: may replay a prior verified result
idempotency_binding.fresh_lease_same_authorized_intent: same intent_fingerprint and semantic mutation identity; no new semantic mutation identity
idempotency_binding.attempt_identity: A fresh attempt identity is mechanical and is distinct from the stable idempotency key and intent fingerprint.
idempotency_binding.reservation_reference: May be reused as evidence for the same semantic intent only; it cannot authorize a changed intent.
